*Website developed with R and Git*

__Public Health AI__

While there is a lot of hesitancy and confusion around AI, I’m here to help bridge the gap. 

My journey into machine learning began during my master’s in Public Health at Columbia University, where I explored data science and artificial intelligence through coursework and hands-on projects. I’ve always been fascinated by how machines can be trained to make decisions and solve complex problems, and over time, I’ve become passionate about how AI can revolutionize healthcare. 

I’m particularly excited about deep learning and natural language processing, as I believe they hold the potential to create transformative solutions in areas like healthcare diagnostics and disease trend predictions. 

My mission is to make AI more accessible, impactful, and equitable for all.

I will highlight a selection of projects that demonstrate my expertise in machine learning and AI. Each project reflects my hands-on experience in solving real-world problems and applying various techniques in the field. Navigate to the top right hand corner to view these projects. 

__Projects__

* Airbnb Rental Price prediction (Python, R): This project predicts Airbnb rental prices in New York City based on data from 2017. 

* Hot Summer Trends (R, Git): This project analyzes weather changes in Boston based on data from 2023
